scene: Title splash page showing Mars, the God of War, striding through space with a flaming torch while a spaceship approaches Planetoid 206 in an inset panel.

dialogue.text: With the horrible war-cry of "Kill and Destroy" on his blood-flecked lips, Mars, God of War, strides across the universe in his eternal search for more victims to satisfy his lust for carnage.

scene: Wad punches Dick Warren in the face while confronting him for interfering with his people.

dialogue.text: UGH!

dialogue.speaker: Ada

dialogue.text: LET'S HURRY!

A queen or ruler seated on a throne questions a group of people, one of whom warns that the crust-people are preparing to attack.
